messages:
jack: Starting staggered rollout for service-router -> v3.1.0 across us-east and eu-west. Plan: us-east 10% -> 30% -> 60% then eu-west 5% -> 25%. Preflight SLO checks enabled. Tagging @priya for routing knobs.

slo-bot: Preflight snapshot (us-east 4m / eu-west 4m): us-east p95=95ms (baseline 92ms), 429s=0.03% ; eu-west p95=110ms (baseline 98ms), 429s=0.28% (baseline 0.04%). Tail error spike in eu-west.

priya: Noted eu-west spike. Any correlation with customer segments or traffic class?

els: Checking route logs for eo-tagged customers. I see elevated retries and 429s coming predominantly from requests marked with route=big-query and multi-part uploads.

sam: Logs: several connection reset / upstream busy messages on embed-lookup cluster behind router: "POST /lookup 429 Too Many Requests" and "error=connection reset by peer". Also seeing ephemeral fd exhaustion on a couple of hosts.

jack: Pause eu-west shift, keep us-east moving. @deploy-bot hold-region eu-west. We need to avoid impacting heavy customers.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused for eu-west by jack. Region status: HOLD at 5%. us-east continues. Incident flag set: region=eu-west, severity=high, tags=[rollout, routing, 429-spike].

oncall-bot: Alert created: RW-INC-6042 "eu-west 429 spike during v3.1.0 rollout". Paging oncall.

priya: Quick mitigation options: 1) rollback eu-west to v3.0.7, 2) pin heavy customers (route=big-query) to stable route table (rolling config), 3) increase upstream pool + fd limits and retry backoff tweak then resume. Rollback is safest but impacts release goals. Thoughts?

els: We can try 2) immediately: add routing override so big-query class hits stable instances only. That is a config change (no image change) and should be quick to flip. 3) will need infra uplift and a short restart window.

sam: +1 config pin for heavy customers. That reduces blast radius and keeps rollout progressing for normal traffic. I can push the routing override in ~2m and run smoke tests.

jack: Do it. @deploy-bot apply-config "route.pin=stable:route=big-query" for eu-west. Keep audit log.

deploy-bot: Applying config override in eu-west: route.pin=stable:route=big-query. Config rollout id=cfg-9912. Smoke tests scheduled.

priya: After override, watch the SLO window for 2 minutes. If 429s don't drop under 0.1% we'll escalate to rollback.

slo-bot: Post-override metrics (1.5m window): eu-west 429s dropped to 0.09%, p95 down to 101ms. Upstream fd errors reduced.

jack: Nice. Hold the patch but continue cautious rollout in us-east. We'll mark eu-west as held until we finish infra uplift tomorrow. Add a bullet to release notes: "paused eu-west image shift due to transient 429s for heavy customers; routing override applied for big-query traffic".

priya: Creating follow-up ticket RW-DEV-7105: "Investigate fd exhaustion & upstream backpressure during v3.1.0" and adding instrumentation checklist (fd usage, client concurrency, retry jitter). Assigning to eng-platform + infra.

sam: Pushed a short announcement to #deploy-watch: "eu-west held; routing override applied; us-east progress unchanged". :loudspeaker:

oncall-bot: RW-INC-6042 updated with remediation steps and runbook link. Next check-in in 09:00 UTC.

jack: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in morning for a decision: resume eu-west after infra fixes or rollback if root cause persists. For now, pin public enterprise customers to the stable route in eu-west and continue monitoring overnight.

priya: Added release-note entry and linked RW-DEV-7105 + RW-INC-6042. Also added a note to the changelog: "hot-config: route pin for big-query traffic in eu-west to mitigate 429 spike during v3.1.0 rollout".

jack: Closing thread — please @oncall if anything flares. :white_check_mark:
